metadata.title: Pork with Perilla and Axone |  Naga Recipe
metadata.description:
In this video I bring to you yet another Northeastern pork recipe from the state of Nagaland. This dish is originally made with smoked pork, however fresh one will also do fine. Pork meat is cooked tender along with fermented soy beans (Axone) and Perilla seeds. An amazing dish with a great depth of flavor, enjoy this dish with steaming hot rice.

Ingredients required

Pork - 500 gms
Fermented soy beans - 1 or 1/2 slab (about 200 gms)
Perilla seeds powder - 40 mg
green chilies - 10-15
Tomatoes - 1 large
Sichuan Pepper - 10 Nos
Salt as required. 

Website: https://rootsandleisure.com/
